propositions: git fetch in review-bot hangs indefinitely on byte-starved connections because no throughput-based abort is configured, burning the 300s timeout instead of failing in seconds
adding http.lowSpeedLimit and http.lowSpeedTime config to git argv enables curl to abort on throughput starvation without killing legitimately slow but progressing transfers
transient low-speed aborts must be retried in-process a bounded number of times so they self-heal within a single review cycle instead of deferring to backfill
git fetch plumbing and stall-abort logic must be extracted from repo_snapshot.py to a new git_fetch.py module to stay within the 800 LOC per-module size cap
voter.py's retryable-gap logic from change 0347 and the 300s timeout ceiling remain unchanged
